pending.definition: Confirmation is still awaited; no settled payment is established.

settled.definition: The payment has retained real settlement evidence; a proposal or signature alone is insufficient.

failed.definition: The operation has a confirmed failure; an unknown financial outcome must instead remain uncertain.

uncertain.definition: The financial outcome is unresolved; reconciliation is required before retrying or counting settlement.

refunded.definition: A refund has verified completion evidence; a refund request alone is insufficient.

expired.definition: The relevant authorization or offer is past its validity period; expiry does not reverse a payment.

simulated.definition: The result is an explicit offline simulation, not a real settlement on either network.

sponsored.definition: An identified sponsor funds the stated cost; sponsorship does not itself establish settlement.

budget.definition: The amount available for the stated task under its existing funding and authorization rules.

cap.definition: The maximum authorized spend for the stated scope, not a target or a settled amount.

reserved.definition: Capacity is held against an obligation; a reservation is not a completed payment.

source-toll.definition: The source-owned fee for accessing the selected content, separate from a citation reward.

citation-reward.definition: The bounded reward allocated to a cited creator under the evidence and payment rules; allocation is not settlement.

creator-payout.definition: A payment to the authorized creator payee; its separate status determines whether it settled.

withdrawal.definition: A transfer out of the applicable funded balance; a request or signature does not prove receipt.

authorization.definition: Permission for a bounded operation; permission alone does not transfer funds.

session.definition: The scoped interaction or grant named by the interface; it does not imply unlimited or perpetual authority.

receipt.definition: A retained record of the stated operation and its evidence; its existence alone does not prove settlement.

testnet.definition: The isolated test network; its activity is not production mainnet settlement or traction.

mainnet.definition: The production network; a network label alone does not establish a successful payment.

buy.definition: The agent selects a purchase subject to authorization, budget and delivery rules; this decision is not settlement.

skip.definition: The agent declines this source or purchase and records its reason.

cache.definition: The agent reuses admitted cached content under existing access rules; this decision does not establish a new payment.

usdc.definition: The asset identifier remains unchanged; recorded amounts and network context retain their existing meaning.

arc.definition: The network name remains unchanged; the specific mainnet or testnet profile must remain explicit.

x402.definition: The payment protocol name remains unchanged; a challenge is not proof of settlement.

legal.english-authoritative.text: This translation is provided for convenience. The English terms of service and privacy policy are authoritative.
